parameter.name: username
parameter.label: TP-Link Account
parameter.description: TP-Link/Kasa account e-mail. Child Things assigned to this bridge use these credentials for local KLAP authentication.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: TP-Link Password
parameter.description: TP-Link/Kasa account password. The password is also used locally by child Things for KLAP authentication.

parameter.name: cloudUrl
parameter.label: Cloud Login URL
parameter.description: TP-Link cloud endpoint used only to validate/maintain the account session. Local device control does not depend on it.

parameter.name: reconnectInterval
parameter.label: Cloud Reconnect Interval
parameter.description: Minutes between cloud login validation attempts. Set to 0 to validate only when the bridge starts.
